# runr_api_consumer (Resource)

A consumer of the API product: someone who calls a gateway's API, such as a customer, identified by its API keys (`runr_api_key`) on key routes or by its JWT subject on JWT routes ([consumers](https://runr.sh/docs/api-product/#consumers)). A consumer belongs to a gateway or to the organization (accepted on every gateway; `api_products.manage`). Deleting it deletes its keys; its usage stays in the reports (`runr gateway usage`).

Import with the consumer id: `terraform import runr_api_consumer.acme 01JC…`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A customer of the gateway's API on the Pro plan; external_id is its number in the invoicing
# system that bills the usage.
resource "runr_api_consumer" "acme" {
  gateway_id  = runr_gateway.eu.id
  name        = "Acme Ltd"
  email       = "api@acme.example"
  external_id = "CUST-1042"
  plan_id     = runr_api_plan.pro.id
  metadata = {
    segment = "enterprise"
  }
}

# A partner identified by the subject of its JWTs on jwt routes, on every gateway of the
# organization (api_products.manage).
resource "runr_api_consumer" "partner" {
  name        = "Partner GmbH"
  jwt_subject = "partner-gmbh"
  plan_id     = runr_api_plan.trial.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, e.g. the customer's.

### Optional

- `email` (String) Contact address (shown only to those who may manage the consumer).
- `external_id` (String) The consumer's id in your own systems (the invoicing system's customer number): in the usage, the usage events and the `X-Runr-Consumer-External` header.
- `gateway_id` (String) Gateway id (`runr_gateway`). Left out: a consumer of the organization, accepted on every gateway. Changing it creates a new consumer (with new keys).
- `jwt_subject` (String) JWT routes: the claim value that names this consumer (unique among the consumers a gateway accepts).
- `metadata` (Map of String) Up to 50 key / value pairs of your own.
- `plan_id` (String) Its plan (`runr_api_plan`): one of the gateway's or of the organization's (an organization consumer: only the organization's). Left out: no limits beyond the gateway's IP rate limit.
- `status` (String) `active` or `suspended` (every key gets 403 `consumer_suspended`). Left out: kept as it is (a new consumer is `active`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Consumer id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <consumer id> (`runr gateway consumers` lists them)
terraform import runr_api_consumer.acme 01JCONSUMER0123456789ABCDE
```
